name: MacroFab, Inc.
old_description: Fix problems, get design feedback, and scale instantly with the power of the most advanced AI platform for PCB assembly.
about:
MacroFab, Inc. is headquartered in Houston, Texas, where it operates an intelligent electronics manufacturing platform that combines AI-driven quoting, sourcing, and production tracking with a vetted network of U.S.-based factories.

The company provides turnkey PCB fabrication (2–36 layers, HDI, blind/buried/micro vias, controlled impedance), PCB assembly (SMD, through-hole, BGA, 01005 components, conformal coating, epoxy potting, IPC-A-610 Class 2/3, J-STD-001), and component sourcing (turnkey, consignment, alternative parts, lifecycle management). Its platform supports volumes from prototype through low‑to‑mid production, with over five million PCBs shipped and 250,000+ quotes generated.

MacroFab serves industrial controls, drones and autonomous systems, test and measurement, and defense/ITAR programs. Customers include Dresser Utility Solutions, VOTRONICS PREMIER, Octavo Systems, Broms Technologies, MannKind, Probe, and Task Force Tips, ranging from OEMs to engineering teams needing rapid iteration.

The company differentiates itself as the only ITAR‑registered self‑service PCB assembly platform, offering dedicated U.S.-based account managers, a fully audited factory network, real‑time BOM and supply‑chain visibility, and no minimum order requirements.
